newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen higher at start.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to move higher at the start of trading on Thursday, following-through on a rally which took the Dow industrials above 7,000 for the first time in almost seven weeks.
But analysts said that the market would remain a prisoner of economic data due out today and Friday and that even a fast start could dissolve into profit-taking later in the day.
"If the numbers are benign, we could continue the rally," said Hildegard Zagorski, analyst at Prudential Securities."
